cases.name: payment_policy_agent
cases.description: an agent bound to a payment policy keeps paymentPolicy, skillVersion and exposePaymentValues in Go's order
cases.input:
vaultDir: /fixture/vault
agents:
  bot:
    approvalMode: prompt
    canWrite: true
    skillPath: /s/p
    skillVersion: "1.2.3"
    exposePaymentValues: true
    paymentPolicy: card
  other:
    canWrite: false
paymentPolicies:
  card:
    instrument: cards/visa
    allowed_merchants: [acme, Beta]
    max_amount:
      per_transaction: "10.00"
      per_day: "50"
    currency: EUR

        approvalMode: prompt

        exposeValueTools: true

    default:
        approvalMode: deny
        canWrite: false
        canRunCommands: false
        exposeValueTools: true
        autoUnseal: false
    hermes:
        approvalMode: deny
        canWrite: true
        canRunCommands: true
        exposeValueTools: true
        autoUnseal: false
        skillPath: ~/.hermes/skills/symvault/SKILL.md
    openclaw:

        canRunCommands: true
        exposeValueTools: true
        autoUnseal: false
        skillPath: ~/.openclaw/skills/symvault/SKILL.md
    opencode:
